description: R2/U2: Enter and Cmd-C in the captured state each put the URI on the macOS pasteboard (change count up) and show a Copied confirmation, two actions from the hotkey
notes: Each round is exactly two user actions: trigger_hotkey, then one key. The steps between them only observe (a11y, pasteboard); no other key or click is sent, which is the 'at most two actions' proof.

The pasteboard starts with a unique nonce (its text is restored at the end of the run); the read must print the fixture URI exactly AND the change count must have risen, so a stale pasteboard cannot pass.
The Copied node is awaited before reading the pasteboard so an asynchronous copy is not raced; the view must keep it visible for at least 1 s (README contract) if it later dismisses itself.
The Cmd-C round runs after a restart (a fresh process, fixtures replayed) so it does not depend on whether the Enter round left the panel open.

steps.name: Enter: a nonce on the pasteboard first
Enter: pbpaste prints the fixture URI, change count higher
fresh instance for the Cmd-C round
Cmd-C: a nonce on the pasteboard first
Cmd-C: pbpaste prints the fixture URI, change count higher
